requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Lexical ambiguity resolved by domain context ('routing switch' as device). Structural concern-mixing detected: functional action ('filter') mixed with quality criterion ('between...'). Decomposed into one functional requirement and one quality requirement per Pohl §25.2.

source_fragments: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic
structured_requirements.final_statement: The routing switch shall filter network traffic.
structuring_notes: Resolved lexical ambiguity: 'Routing switches ability' interpreted as 'The routing switch has the ability to...'. Extracted core functional action.

source_fragments: between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic

fields.measurable_criterion: separation between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic

structured_requirements.final_statement: The routing switch shall filter network traffic to ensure separation between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (traffic segregation) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2. Note: While the original text implies a quality constraint, it is phrased as a functional requirement for the switch's behavior. To strictly separate concerns, the 'separation' aspect is treated as the quality attribute defining the functional behavior.
